rounds.text: The strongest evidence for a bullish thesis lies in the significant accumulation of equity by insiders, with promoter holdings rising from 48.18% in 2020 to 71.13% as of March 2026, including a 5.26% increase in the most recent quarter [E37, E42]. This aggressive alignment of interest suggests that those closest to the business anticipate a turnaround, further supported by the completion of capital expenditure projects as evidenced by the 100% reduction in capital work-in-progress [E36]. While the company faces operational headwinds, recent performance shows a 24% year-over-year sales increase and positive sequential growth, indicating that the business is successfully scaling its top line [E50, E52]. The market has begun to recognize this potential, as evidenced by the 133% share price growth over the last year [E20]. Conceded: the company reports negative return on equity [E8, E12], negative operating cash flow [E30], and a high price-to-earnings ratio relative to the sector [E5]. Despite these challenges, the combination of strong promoter conviction and recent sales momentum provides a compelling case for those looking beyond current accounting losses [E37, E42, E50].

The most compelling evidence for a bullish outlook is the significant increase in promoter confidence, as evidenced by their stake rising from 48.18% in 2020 to 71.13% in 2026, including a 5.26% increase in the most recent quarter [E37, E42]. This aggressive accumulation suggests that insiders see value that the current market capitalization of ₹ 21.3 Cr has yet to fully reflect [E2]. Furthermore, the completion of capital expenditure, indicated by the 100% reduction in capital work in progress, suggests the company is transitioning from a phase of investment to one of operational capacity [E36]. While the stock has seen recent volatility, it has demonstrated strong momentum with 133% growth over the last year [E20]. Conceded: the company faces significant headwinds, including negative return on equity [E8, E12, E24], negative operating cash flow [E30], and a sharp decline in compounded profit growth [E17]. Despite these challenges, the recent 11% growth in trailing twelve-month sales [E16] and the 24% year-over-year sales increase flagged by the screen [E50] indicate that the underlying business engine is beginning to generate top-line traction.
